mapper.sql: id, code, protocol, status, login_page_visible, display_order, unlinked_identity_action, auto_link_verified_email, i18n::text AS i18n, icon_reference, version
mapper.select: SELECT provider.protocol, issuer, client_id, client_secret_key_id AS secret_key_id, client_secret_ciphertext AS secret_ciphertext, authorization_endpoint, token_endpoint, userinfo_endpoint AS user_info_endpoint, jwks_endpoint, client_authentication, scopes::text AS scopes, profile_mapping::text AS profile_mapping, authorization_parameters::text AS authorization_parameters FROM auth_federated_provider_configuration configuration JOIN auth_federated_provider provider ON provider.id = configuration.provider_id WHERE configuration.provider_id = #{providerId} AND configuration.deleted = 0 AND provider.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_federated_provider (code, protocol, status, login_page_visible, display_order, unlinked_identity_action, auto_link_verified_email, i18n, icon_reference) VALUES (#{code}, #{protocol}, #{status}, #{loginPageVisible}, #{displayOrder}, #{unlinkedIdentityAction}, #{autoLinkVerifiedEmail}, #{i18n,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{iconReference})
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_federated_provider provider SET deleted = 1, version = version + 1 WHERE provider.code = #{code} AND provider.status = 'DISABLED' AND provider.deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_federated_identity identity WHERE identity.provider_id = provider.id AND identity.deleted = 0 ) AND provider.version = #{expectedVersion}
UPDATE auth_federated_provider_configuration SET deleted = 1 WHERE provider_id = #{providerId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_federated_provider_configuration (provider_id, issuer, client_id, client_secret_key_id, client_secret_ciphertext, authorization_endpoint, token_endpoint, userinfo_endpoint, jwks_endpoint, client_authentication, scopes, profile_mapping, authorization_parameters) VALUES (#{providerId}, #{issuer}, #{clientId}, #{secretKeyId}, #{secretCiphertext}, #{authorizationEndpoint}, #{tokenEndpoint}, #{userInfoEndpoint}, #{jwksEndpoint}, #{clientAuthentication}, CAST(#{scopes} AS JSONB), CAST(#{profileMapping} AS JSONB), CAST(#{authorizationParameters} AS JSONB))
